faqs.question: More Info on ROS1 Gene Rearrangement by FISH Test
faqs.answer: The discovery of a variety of genetic alterations in non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has enabled the use of targeted therapy such as the anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) inhibitor, crizotinib, and the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) tyrosine kinase inhibitor, erlotinib, for NSCLC with ALK rearrangements and EGFR mutations, respectively. The c-ros oncogene 1 (ROS1), has been identified as a potential relevant therapeutic target in lung adenocarcinoma.s.
